title: Build the missing capacitor
story: A timing circuit needs about 3.2 uF so that, charged from 5 V through 1 kOhm, it crosses 2.5 V between 2.0 ms and 2.45 ms. Nobody sells 3.2 uF, but there are two empty pads side by side (in parallel) and a box of standard capacitors. Fill both pads.

goals.label: crosses 2.5 V between 2.0 ms and 2.45 ms

hints: Capacitors side by side (in parallel) add up: C = C1 + C2.
Crossing half the supply takes 0.693 x R x C. With R = 1 kOhm, 2.0 ms to 2.45 ms means C between about 2.9 uF and 3.5 uF.
Which two values from the box add up to something in that window?
